name: quantum-algorithms
description: Use this skill when the user says 'quantum algorithms overview', 'which problems have quantum speedup', 'QFT', 'phase estimation', 'VQE', 'QAOA', 'HHL', 'quantum advantage', 'is my problem suitable for quantum', 'dequantization'. Surveys the main quantum algorithm families, their proven or heuristic speedups, the assumptions that make speedups real (oracles, state preparation, readout, error correction), and how to assess a use case honestly. Do NOT use for: deep dives on Grover (quantum-computing/grovers-algorithm) or Shor (quantum-computing/shors-algorithm), SDK usage (quantum-computing/qiskit-framework), or QEC (quantum-computing/quantum-error-correction).
